entities.description: An elderly woman with a weathered face and dark hair sits facing forward, wearing a large, deep red fringed shawl draped over her head and shoulders. She wears a dark long-sleeved top and a dark purple skirt, with her hands clasped in her lap, positioned next to another person wearing a green patterned shawl.

A young boy with short dark hair and a serious expression sits on a wooden stool, wearing a dusty, brownish-grey work uniform consisting of a button-down shirt and matching trousers. He has a blue collared shirt visible underneath the uniform, and his hands are clasped together in his lap.

entities.description: A woman with dark hair and a serious expression stands in the background wearing a maroon headscarf and shawl, positioned behind a young boy in a brown jacket and an older woman in a green floral headscarf.
